native_mechanisms: Fold one crease per mark in strict order, each crease's angle set by both the mark and the crease before it (sequential chained state).
Test every crease against all four wire birds' beaks at once and refold tighter until all four agree (four coupled gauges of the same crease, no independent partial answers).
Thin the whole folded wad down to one small dense corner and destroy every scrap and failed reading (irreversible wide-state-to-single-word finalization).
core_technique: SipHash-style 4x64-bit coupled state: each 32-byte block XORed one word per lane, then two SipRounds of ARX cross-mixing (so every lane becomes a function of all four) with a second cross-lane re-injection of the same words, plus length-seeded IVs, 8-byte tail path, three finalization rounds, XOR-fold of all four lanes and a MurmurHash3 fmix64 tail.
